data.creative: Founder-style 'why OTC fails on verrucas' armour mechanism explainer · 807447922106734
data.hook: Why won't over-the-counter treatments work on verrucas?
data.desire: Finally get rid of a stubborn verruca that keeps returning
data.angle: Most treatments miss what's happening beneath the hardened skin
data.belief_shift: from 'verrucas are impossible, I've tried it all' → to 'past fixes couldn't get through the armour; this softens it layer by layer'
data.script_structure: question hook → it's not impossible, treatments miss beneath → decade helping people → hardened skin acts like armour → burn, freeze, scrape leave it underneath, comes back thicker → partnered with third-party lab → plant formula softens skin → what happens when you apply → twice a day, few weeks → UK shipping + 90-day guarantee → click below
data.mechanism_reveal: Claim: verrucas grow under 'thick, compacted tissue' that 'acts like armour' blocking surface treatments; the oils loosen and soften that skin so it can 'renew itself layer by layer', then the area dries, shrinks and flakes.
data.proof: Credential look (smiling man in a lab coat, 'over a decade'), 'third-party lab' with Third Party Tested badge, cross-section animations, a step-by-step application sequence, kids and parents using it, 90-day guarantee card.
data.cta: Click below to try H-Warts Formula today; fast UK shipping, 90-day money-back guarantee, 'zero risk'.
data.why_it_works: Interpretation of execution, not measured performance: The question hook promises an answer to a frustration the viewer already has, and the armour metaphor makes every past failure make sense. The 'what happens when you apply it' sequence lets the viewer picture the result step by step.
data.transferable_move: Open with 'Why doesn't X work for Y?', give one physical metaphor for the hidden barrier (armour), then narrate 'here's what happens when you apply it' in stages. Soften: say rough, thick skin instead of disease names and avoid shrink claims.
data.opening_visual: Freezing spray gun blasting a toe, caption 'Why won't OTC treatments work on verrucas?'
data.transition_to_product: 0:08.4, a smiling man in a lab coat holds the bottle (red arrow) on 'We've spent over a decade helping people'; named at 0:48.9.
data.proof_placement: Lab/third-party badge follows the 'different path' turn (0:35); animations follow the armour and renewal lines; guarantee card follows the shipping line (1:29).
data.transcript:
Automatic transcript (en) from the original ad audio (Whisper, run locally 2026-11-10). Recognition errors may remain in names; numbers and claims are the advertiser's.
[0.0–2.5] Why won't over-the-counter treatments work on verrucas?
[2.5–4.3] It's not that they're impossible to manage,
[4.3–7.2] it's that most treatments miss what's happening beneath the surface.
[7.2–12.4] We've spent over a decade helping people finally break free from the frustration of stubborn verrucas.
[12.4–15.0] And most are shocked when they learn why nothing else worked.
[15.0–17.7] verrucas grow deep underneath layers of hardened skin.
[17.7–20.3] That thick, compacted tissue acts like armour,
[20.3–23.6] blocking most surface level treatments from reaching where the problem begins.
[23.6–26.0] You can burn, freeze or scrape the surface.
[26.0–28.2] And the issue often just sits quietly underneath.
[28.2–30.5] That's why so many people see them come right back,
[30.5–33.3] sometimes even thicker or more uncomfortable than before.
[33.3–34.7] So we took a different path.
[34.7–39.9] We partnered with a third party lab to create something that works with the skin's natural process.
[39.9–43.9] Together we developed a natural plant-based formula that helps soften the thick skin,
[43.9–48.9] covering the Veruka, so the skin can gently renew itself layer by layer over time.
[48.9–50.7] It's called H-Warts Formula,
[50.7–54.0] and it's built around some of nature's most time-tested botanicals.
[54.0–55.8] Here's what happens when you apply it.
[55.8–59.1] The oils start by loosening and softening the surface around the Veruka,
[59.1–62.4] helping to break down the rough, hardened skin that's been building up.
[62.4–66.3] As you keep applying it, the area begins to dry, shrink and flake naturally,
[66.3–68.8] allowing healthy new skin to gradually appear.
[68.8–71.5] That's the quiet secret behind H-Warts Formula.
[71.5–75.1] It's gentle, easy to use, and works without acids, freezing or pain.
[75.1–77.2] You just apply it topically, twice a day.
[77.2–81.7] And within a few weeks, many people notice their Veruka starting to flatten and fade in appearance,
[81.7–84.5] leaving skin that looks smoother and feels more comfortable.
[84.5–87.7] Right now, H-Warts Formula is available with fast UK shipping,
[87.7–92.1] and backed by a 90-day money-back guarantee, so there's zero risk in giving it a try.
[92.1–95.9] If you've been dealing with a persistent area of thickened skin caused by Veruka's,
[95.9–98.2] click below to try H-Warts Formula today.
[98.2–100.9] You'll be amazed how your skin responds once you let nature do the work.
